sources.scar_add_dataset: High resolution vector polygons of the Antarctic coastline

motivation: Zero-tolerance point-in-polygon assigns 511/729 MAPPPD sites uniquely but leaves 218 coastal site points outside land polygons, including known island sites such as Beaufort Island. Resolve coordinate/coastline mismatch without using demographic outcomes.

assignment_rule.fallback: for a site with no direct land match, query the listed tolerances in ascending order and accept the first tolerance returning exactly one land polygon
assignment_rule.ambiguity: if a tolerance returns multiple land polygons, do not select among them; continue only if a later tolerance is not used to override that ambiguity. Mark ambiguous.
assignment_rule.unresolved: if no tolerance through 5000 m returns exactly one polygon, leave unresolved

landmass_definition.mainland_operational_definition: the assigned land polygon with the largest Shape__Area among all uniquely assigned MAPPPD sites
landmass_definition.island_operational_definition: any uniquely assigned land polygon other than the operational mainland polygon
landmass_definition.note: This identifies physically separated landmasses; it does not imply demographic independence.

analysis_boundary: No tolerance outside the frozen grid may be introduced after results are opened.
No site may be assigned by its name when the geometric rule is unresolved or ambiguous.
The geometry audit is preprocessing only; no population synchrony effect is calculated in this stage.
